Dependencies
============

Goal: keep both .exe files small and standalone, and only ask you to download
the things Windows expects you to configure yourself (never libraries we can
just bundle or link in).

What is ALREADY inside the .exe files (nothing to download)
-----------------------------------------------------------
Everything the programs are built from is compiled straight into the two .exe
files: the whole network stack, screen capture, JPEG encoding, audio, the
random-number and crypto code, and — for the teacher app — the entire web
interface (HTML/CSS/JS). The Visual C++ runtime is statically linked in too, so
you do NOT need the "Visual C++ Redistributable" that most Windows programs ask
for.

The only Windows pieces they call are ones that are part of Windows itself and
are always present (kernel32, user32, gdi32, ws2_32, crypt32, bcrypt, d3d11 for
screen capture, mmdevapi for audio, wtsapi32 for sessions, and so on). Nothing
to install for those.

What you may need to configure yourself (NOT bundled, on purpose)
----------------------------------------------------------------
1. Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime  —  teacher app only (cowatcher-console.exe)

   The teacher window is drawn with WebView2, the same engine Edge uses. We do
   NOT ship it, because Windows already ships it:

     * Windows 11 .......................... always present
     * Windows 10, version 21H2 or newer ... present (came with a Windows update)
     * Older Windows 10 .................... may be missing

   If the teacher app opens to a blank/white window on an older Windows 10,
   install the free "Evergreen" runtime once:

     https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/

   The student program (cowatcher-agent.exe) does NOT use WebView2 and needs
   nothing here.

2. ffmpeg  —  student PC only, OPTIONAL (for recording with real codecs)

   Recording works out of the box (a built-in MJPEG .avi writer). To record with
   H.264/H.265/AV1, a chosen preset, quality (CRF), B-frames and the lanczos
   scaler instead, drop a single "ffmpeg.exe" next to cowatcher-agent.exe on the
   student PC (or have it on PATH). The agent finds it automatically; without it
   recording simply falls back to MJPEG.

   Get a Windows build from https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/ (the small
   "essentials" build is enough). We do NOT bundle it, to keep the download
   small and the licensing clean — ffmpeg stays a separate program.

The full-resolution viewer (cowatcher-viewer.exe) is like the student program
here: everything is built in (H.264 decode, the window, Direct3D), it does NOT
use WebView2, and it needs nothing extra. Keep it in the same folder as the
teacher app, which launches it.

Summary
-------
                          agent.exe    console.exe                 viewer.exe
  Visual C++ runtime      built in     built in                   built in
  WebView2 runtime        not used     needs it (Win 10 21H2+/11)  not used
  Any other download      none         none                       none

64-bit Windows 10 (1809+) or Windows 11 is assumed. There is no 32-bit build.
